patterns.note: Content sections frequently pair a large, custom illustration on one side with a concise text block and call-to-action on the other, often alternating the illustration's position (left/right) for visual variety.
Headings are set in a large, bold, and friendly sans-serif, creating a clear hierarchy that guides the eye, while body text maintains high readability with a slightly lighter weight.
The brand's vibrant green is used as a dominant accent for backgrounds, buttons, and key visual elements, providing a consistent and energetic brand presence throughout the site.
The header transforms into a sticky navigation bar upon scrolling, with the Duolingo logo and site language selector remaining fixed at the top for persistent access.
Extensive use of custom, character-based illustrations that appear to be animated, adding a dynamic and playful quality to content sections and reinforcing the brand's friendly tone.
Sections are clearly delineated by full-width background colors, primarily white and the brand's signature green, with one notable dark blue section providing strong contrast.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that transitions from a static position to a fixed position at the top of the viewport after a user scrolls past a certain threshold, ensuring the main navigation is always accessible.

Integrate Lottie animations for all key illustrations, ensuring they are optimized for web and potentially triggered to play on section entry or hover for enhanced interactivity, bringing the characters to life.

Design content blocks with a clear visual hierarchy, using large, bold sans-serif headings for immediate impact and smaller, readable body text for detailed information, often accompanied by a prominent call-to-action button.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, creating a friendly yet authoritative hierarchy with a consistent sans-serif family.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding is applied to buttons and some card-like elements, contributing to a soft and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, particularly in the hero section, with consistent vertical spacing between content blocks and a well-defined grid for feature displays.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its extensive and consistent use of custom, highly expressive, and likely animated character illustrations. These playful figures are central to explaining concepts and guiding the user, making the learning experience feel exceptionally engaging and unique compared to typical educational platforms.
